description: Ministry of Health - Upgrading of District General Hospital Kalutara as a Teaching Hospital
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the upgrading of the Kalutara District General Hospital to a Teaching Hospital to facilitate clinical training for medical students. This content pertains to health sector infrastructure and educational development, which falls under the "Educational matters" or "Health sector announcements" specified in the Miscellaneous (Type 10) category. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any of the specialized administrative categories (Types 4-9).
